lines.trans: Put on your hat! We are late!
I do not want to put on the hat.
You will catch a cold outside without it.
And I do not want to go to kindergarten at all!
Why such a bad mood, Alexei?
Because there is a craft contest there today.
And I do not know how to make crafts at all.
Everything will be fine with you, do you believe me?
Everyone will bring beautiful things, except me.
There is nothing terrible about that.
The main thing is, do not worry.
We will make an excellent craft together!
We really will? Thank you, Uncle Arkasha!
